title: Require structural wheel gates to beat shape-matched rejection and recover rare exception support
statement: A 52-bit ordinal role map learned from ZL reduces median Stolfi exception mass to .328/.330/.329 in ZL/IT/RF public layouts, from .380/.379/.383. Length-conditioned random thinning gives .334/.329/.331, and the witnessed masses are .051/.047/.055. Mean paired differences versus thinning are −.00564, −.00172 and +.00051, with 95% leaf resampling intervals [−.01120,−.00062], [−.00646,+.00397], and [−.00417,+.00562]. The effect beyond thinning is small in ZL and unresolved in IT and RF. In the exact unshared proposal distribution, the order gate and its matched thinning give .33010 and .33216 at the same acceptance probability, .62530. A 152-bit projected trigram alternative accepts 99.987% of unshared proposals and leaves exception rates near baseline. The order rule worsens token-length variation in all witnesses and retains a gap of at least .013 in length-matched one-edit rates. It thus falls short of the joint exception and neighborhood targets.
check: Freeze a shape-matched comparison for any further gate, including both length and accepted specialist-bank mix. Choose a train-only compact form with nontrivial rate on independent proposals, measure its gate representation under a stated coding convention, and preregister a joint target for held-apart exception type coverage, token and type length, and length-matched near-neighbor rates. Keep folio and seed uncertainty separate. If a candidate transfers to the independent transcription and clears the public targets, seek review of a scorer primitive before applying it to the closed pages.
method: Keep the inherited 24 x 24 x 24 proposal wheels in each bank, fixed bank mixture, clipped EVA-basic length weights and 10% attempted sharing of one fragment on a resolvable same-bank continuation. The soft gate accepts a failed proposal with probability .1; redraw fully on rejection with only the last accepted word available to copying. Fit both proposed gates on ZL training excluding all sibling sides and panels of public evaluation leaves. The four role classes come from positional enrichment of raw EVA glyphs, requiring an enrichment at least twice its runner-up and 20 training appearances. The ordinal gate ignores neutral codes and requires nondecreasing roles. The trigram gate checks the boundary-augmented role trigrams from at least five distinct training word types. Controls include ungated and P-G-033 bigram arms, and randomized thinning for each new gate conditional on proposal length in the unshared wheel distribution. Use separate proposal and gate streams and report ten seed medians; the new replay and its predecessor have different RNG coupling. Compare synthetic pair rates under common length strata among all arms within each seed.
metrics: Repeated score in three public layouts, including Stolfi NormalWord exception token share, type and token length total variation, accepted bank and sharing rates, effort, formal hard-admission and realized unseen exception coverage, and length-matched one-edit and repeat rates. Paired bootstrap of numeric leaves is on exception-rate changes averaged across seeds. The exact unshared balance check is a supplementary analysis. Parameter bits use fixed alphabet bitmaps and a fixed 2-bit role code, exclude shared wheels and fixed rule implementations, and do not measure total code length of the full generator.
limitations: The inherited banks and fitted length weights were obtained from the original ZL practice training scope; the bank construction used Stolfi ordinary/exception assignments. New gate inputs excluded evaluation leaf siblings and used only raw character sequences. The abbreviation RF here denotes the composite transliteration. All witnesses read one manuscript. The thinning rate is exactly matched by length when sharing is disabled; with sharing, realized effort and bank composition may differ. Positive escape acceptance preserves the original formal wheel support. Exact scope of exception support here is the exposed public conditioning and Stolfi grammar, and within-seed supported pair strata may vary with seed/witness. No private scoring data were used.

design.layout: Public practice paragraph ASCII sequences exactly as in P-G-033
design.new_gate_training: ZL public practice training minus all evaluation numeric leaves
design.primary_gate: Position-role order with neutral, early, middle and late ranks
design.role_assignment: Words of at least three raw EVA characters, midpoint-indexed thirds, at least 20 token occurrences, strongest smoothed enrichment at least twice the runner-up
design.secondary_gate: Boundary-augmented trigrams over the same four roles, supported by at least five distinct ZL training word types
design.matched_thinning: Exact proportion accepted for unshared bank-weighted proposals conditional on resulting EVA length, then apply to all proposed words of that length
design.uncertainty: Seed range and paired bootstrap of numeric leaves on mean seed page-level counts
design.emission_coding: Finite rule representations over shared a-z; role map as 2 bits per glyph; bigram bitmap as 26*26+2*26 cells; projected trigram mask as 4*4*4+2*4*4+4 cells. Quote gate-only bits.

reproduction: Extract reproduction_python as evaluate.py and banks as banks.json from this file. Acquire the grammar HTML at the source link and verify the pinned digest. From the project root with verified practice corpus files, run PYTHONPATH=. python3 /path/evaluate.py data/raw /path/banks.json /path/stolfi-grammar.html.
